name: L2 Euclidean Distance Nearest Neighbors Search via array_distance
description: In computer vision feature retrieval (facial recognition, product image matching), feature vectors are compared using Euclidean (L2) distance where lower distance equals higher visual similarity.
prompt:
In computer vision feature retrieval (facial recognition, product image matching), feature vectors are compared using Euclidean (L2) distance where lower distance equals higher visual similarity.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: image_id, label, l2_distance.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Find visual nearest neighbors to query image vector [1.05, 2.05, 3.0]
            SELECT 
                image_id,
                label,
                ROUND(array_distance(vector, [1.05, 2.05, 3.0]::FLOAT[3]), 4) AS l2_distance
            FROM image_features
            ORDER BY l2_distance ASC
            LIMIT 2;
why_it_fails: LLMs often try to write SQRT(SUM(POW(a - b, 2))) which prevents vectorized hardware acceleration.
